( I haven’t been give no bills because I haven’t allowed them to shoot)

Cons
-lack of professional
-over charged
-It was a bad experience overall 1/10
- Window was not fixed properly his guy is still on his way
-complained about temple light still no help
-After your money is gone they don’t won’t fix anything even if it’s not caused from your end.
-they left the work incomplete all the cement filling I had to get it redone
Definitely not happy for the services I wanted to share pictures for the proof but I’m not allowed to for some reason.

Please prefer a professional over them cause it’s still going to cost you hefty :)
